body:
Filing-gate category: ③ — a maintainer-directed task. Filed by the `domain:skills#1` seat (`session_01LNRg6FUMXYWgkAbDsfZpC8`) under the direct-dispatch channel; the audit comment on this card quotes the authorization verbatim.

## Maintainer's words (verbatim, this seat's chat, 2026-09-24/25, ⛔ not translated)

The question: 「现在pr都是车队提交的，有点分不清是谁在处理，是否建议也写入 assignee，包括pr被接管时应该更新 assignee」

The seat's recommendation, given in chat: PR assignee = the card's assignee (the dispatching seat's linked user account), set by the dev right after `pr_create` with the label-write tool; a takeover moves every open PR's assignee of that card in the same stroke as the card's; a seat's own tool PR is assigned to the seat; the reader is the filter `is:pr is:open assignee:LOGIN`; no new patrol row unless the maintainer names one.

The ruling: 「同意」

## What lands (rule text only; ⛔ no gate, no patrol row, no new tool)

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`, 认领 section — one rule: the dev's `pr_create` is followed by `label-write --issue PR_NUMBER --assign` with the card's assignee; the takeover four-piece (C9) moves the assignee of every open PR of the card in the same stroke (`--unassign old --assign new` on the PR number too); a seat's own PR is assigned to the seat. The file sits at its line ceiling (183 / 183): pay every added line with a deletion or an in-place rewrite, ⛔ never a re-wrap.
2. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, rule 2 (「你恒不写 assignee」) narrowed to the CARD's assignee, and the write budget line (「写预算四笔」) naming the PR-assignee write as the label-write slot it already has; the standard clause that objectui path labels belong to the labeler is unchanged.
3. Any other reader of the assignee rule found by a sweep of `.claude/**` and `AGENTS.md` for `assignee` — listed in the PR body with a per-hit decision (changed / already consistent / out of scope with reason).

Pilot already run: PRs objectui#10410, #10412, #10413 carry assignee `os-elon-musk` (= the cards' assignee), set by their devs through the relay; the measured spelling is `node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --repo OWNER/NAME --issue PR_NUMBER --assign LOGIN` (the relay's `assign` op, `POST /issues/{n}/assignees`, works on a PR number).
